title: Land and Live in the UK
subtitle: Everything to know before you land, your first 30 days, and living well in the United Kingdom
description:
The complete Land and Live guide to the United Kingdom, written by the Naara Family for people preparing to travel to, move to, study in or work in the UK.

This first part covers the honest reality check, visas and staying legal, the real cost of living with three monthly budgets, documents and health preparation, and getting connected before you land. Every figure carries the date it was checked, and where a fact could not be confirmed from an official source it says so.

General information, not legal, immigration, tax or medical advice.
